study.question: The unchanged joint incumbent g0-r0022-support_rotated_attached has click AUC 0.666753548 versus baseline-din 0.655544082, a +0.011209465 benchmark gain with worse auxiliary performance; four-task mean AUC falls from 0.809923388 to 0.747602516. The initial token-removal/replacement branch g1-r0024-token_zero_task/zero_shared/context_task is much weaker (0.641190007/0.640708560/0.641429687), while g1-r0024-token_observed_shared reaches 0.664993709. The scorer-only action branch g1-r0025-action_score_task/shared reaches 0.654174128/0.653846387, whereas the value-only branch g1-r0025-action_value_task/shared reaches 0.666244430/0.664748800. Within values, g1-r0026-pool_action_task/shared reaches 0.660764385/0.660048443 and g1-r0026-summary_action_task/shared 0.659964847/0.652078622. Both value paths exceed either isolated path, but the descriptive pool-by-summary AUC interaction (both - pool-only - summary-only + zero-token) is NEGATIVE: -0.013294794 task, -0.006669706 shared. The summary-only localization branch g1-r0027-match_summary_task/shared reaches 0.651462535/0.648325486 and g1-r0027-ordinal_summary_task/shared 0.653009136/0.645130243, all below full summaries. Thus earlier failures reject sufficiency of these isolated implementations at this seed, not feedback utility or a universal summary-family mechanism. No execution failures appear in the current 18-entry trajectory index; null/negative scientific outcomes remain retained. All are full validation observations at one seed; no held-out results or confidence intervals are available. The unanswered question is whether either partial summary family becomes sufficient when pooled action information is restored, and whether that conditional sufficiency changes with residual-bank readout. Does pooled action change the predictive value of match versus ordinal action summaries and its dependence on task-specific versus shared residual-bank readout?
study.hypothesis: The weak summary-only implementations may lack coarse pooled action composition rather than demonstrate that their remaining family is intrinsically useless. Restoring the existing pooled action coordinates may let a partial summary family recover most of the full-value model. The primary directional hypothesis is that with pool action present, target-match action summaries (indices 0/4) are sufficient within 0.0015 click AUC of the all-summary value-only endpoint and exceed ordinal-only summaries (indices 1/2/3); task-specific bank readout may change this contrast. This is a falsifiable, provisional branch choice, not a claim supported by the previous summary-only ranking, which reverses between readouts. All conclusions remain conditional on the retained feedback masks and the frozen offline recipe.
